axes.model_access: The model family is disclosed via xAI's official release pages and press releases (the Grok iteration line); models available on grok.com and inside X may not be in sync. This site's direct fetch of x.ai sitewide is blocked by Cloudflare, so model tier routing was not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (grok.com), iOS/Android apps; an embedded Grok entry inside the X platform; generation is processed on xAI's cloud.
axes.local_files: Supports image generation and editing, and file input; uploaded content is stored in the xAI account — retention and deletion are covered by the permissions dimension (deleted data is removed from systems within 30 days, official Consumer FAQ).
axes.background: Chats return instantly with no offline task queue; there is no official statement of an "offline continuation" form — the long-task form is xAI Grok Bot (a cloud task-type agent, a separate dossier under the coding category).
axes.tools: Real-time web search and public X post retrieval are the core differentiators; there is also xAI Grok Bot (a cloud task-type agent, a separate dossier under coding) and a standalone API line.
axes.context: Style/persona is adjustable; the cross-session memory mechanism is not documented item by item officially (this site has not verified official docs for a standalone memory-management entry).
axes.permissions: Official Consumer FAQ: your content and Grok replies may be used for model training by default — turn it off via App "Settings → Data Controls → Improve the model" or grok.com "Settings → Data → Improve the Model"; Private Chat is not used for training; enterprise and API content is not used for training. For unauthenticated use, the official FAQ says content may be retained anonymously, and some regions (excluding EU/UK) have no training opt-out option. Using Grok inside X falls under X's privacy policy — a separate set of terms.
axes.fit: For people who want live X information. Confirm two hard boundaries first: unauthenticated use may have no training opt-out option; inside X it is X's terms, not xAI's. For contract-grade data terms go the API/enterprise line.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).
